name: WazirX Multisig
technique: UI Transaction Substitution; Multisig Upgrade Path Abuse; Interface-Based Phishing
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the RevertIQ label and description.
rootCause: On July 18, 2024, attackers exploited a critical transaction interface mismatch in WazirX’s Ethereum multisig wallet (co-managed with Liminal). Through UI spoofing, three signers approved a malicious Safe implementation upgrade, which then drained over $230M in assets, mainly SHIB, ETH, and USDT. Attackers substituted a malicious contract upgrade payload via the Liminal custody signing interface, tricking hardware wallet signers into approving a transaction whose signed hash did not match its UI description. The Safe multisig wallet was upgraded to an attacker-controlled implementation and drained, without any evidence of direct key or device compromise.
